base.prompt: A still from a stylized animated feature film, painted like a living watercolor. Medium shot at the head of a family dinner table. A girl of about thirteen sits centred, facing the camera: warm brown skin, a round face, freckles across her nose and dark curly shoulder-length hair. Her head is gently bowed and her eyes are closed in a quiet moment of saying grace; she smiles slightly. Both arms reach out to the sides, holding hands with family members whose hands enter from the edges of the frame; their faces are out of frame. The edge of a wooden table with plates and a jug runs along the bottom of the frame. Behind her is a tall window with sheer curtains, and a potted plant with long leaves stands on the left. Soft backlight from the window. Style: an expressive 3D character painted over with wet-on-wet watercolor washes, loose sketchy ink accents, and vertical brush striations that dissolve the background into abstract colour; a cyan, orange and violet palette. Symmetrical composition with her face in the upper centre. No text.
